changes.evidence: The Red Room is her past: she defected and killed Dreykov before joining S.H.I.E.L.D. In episode 14 (S2E5, 'What If... Captain Carter Fought the Hydra Stomper?') she fights the Red Room alongside Peggy; she never rejoins it. Her S2 flashback shows her in the Avengers at the Battle of New York, and she ends the episode at Avengers Tower. The Red Room stage at S2 wrongly puts her back in the Red Room after S.H.I.E.L.D.

In episode 21 (S3E3, 'What If... the Red Guardian Stopped the Winter Soldier?'), Bill Foster recruits Shostakov to help the U.S. Twenty-one years later he joins the Avengers at the Battle of New York, pushing into their circle between Captain America and Black Widow. Marvel Database also lists his affiliation as Avengers.

This is the same Steve Rogers as A:by-steve-rogers-stomper, from Captain Carter's universe in 'What If...? S1E1' and episode 14 (S2E5). Marvel Database designates him Earth-82111. The villain file has null (main MCU), which is wrong.

Steve's U.S. Army, SSR and Howling Commandos stages all happen in episode 1 (S1E1, 'What If... Captain Carter Were the First Avenger?'), not S2. The twin file A:by-steve-rogers-stomper already dates them to S1. This file is only on file for S2, so the owner may prefer to keep S2 here.

owner_calls.question: In What If...? S3 (episode 26, 'What If... What If?'), the Watcher turns on the Order of the Watchers: he escapes their trial and fights them, and they lose their powers. He then invites Kahhori, Byrdie and Storm to watch the multiverse with him. Does that count as leaving the Order and forming a new group? If so, does Storm (A:by-storm) also move from Guardians of the Multiverse into the Watchers in S3?
options: Keep 'The Watchers' (from the start) for Uatu and Guardians of the Multiverse for Storm
Add a stage for Uatu in What If...? S3 (e.g. a new Watchers group with Kahhori, Byrdie and Storm), and add a matching S3 stage for Storm
owner_calls.evidence: MCU Wiki lists Uatu's affiliation as 'Order of the Watchers (formerly)' and calls the Order 'Temporary Enemies'. Wikipedia's S3E8 summary says the Watcher 'invites Kahhori, Byrdie, and Storm to join him in watching over the multiverse.'
